column5: query (endpoint https://dbpedia.org/sparql, live; not the 2022.12.01 release files)
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?p a owl:FunctionalProperty . FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?p), "http://dbpedia.org/ontology/")) }

SELECT ?p ?o WHERE { <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Tokyo> ?p ?o . FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?p), "http://dbpedia.org/property/") && (CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?p)),"leader") || CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?p)),"governor") || CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?p)),"term"))) } LIMIT 30
